data.description:
Staff Software Developer (Remote Canada)

About Our Client

Our client is a technology company transforming the building supply industry through modern digital solutions. Their platform helps independent building suppliers deliver exceptional customer experiences by streamlining commerce, sales, accounts receivable, operations, and customer service.

They are a curious, solution-driven, customer-focused team that is passionate about building technology that solves real-world problems and helps businesses operate more efficiently.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly autonomous Staff Software Developer to join our client's growing engineering team.

This is not a role where you will simply be assigned tickets. You will act as a true product and technical partner, taking ownership of complex engineering challenges, designing scalable solutions, and directly influencing the evolution of the platform.

You will work across the stack, help shape architecture decisions, improve engineering practices, and build solutions that integrate seamlessly with customer systems and workflows. You will leverage modern development tools, including AI-powered technologies and LLMs, to accelerate development, improve productivity, and deliver meaningful business impact.

What You'll Do

Own the Full Development Lifecycle
Design, architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable features across web and mobile platforms using modern engineering practices.

Drive Platform Integrations
Build infrastructure, tools, and processes that improve efficiency and significantly reduce the time required to onboard and integrate new customers.

Partner with Product and Business Teams
Collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure engineering decisions align with business objectives and customer needs.

Support Customer-Facing Engineering Initiatives
Work directly with customers and technology partners when needed to understand requirements, solve technical challenges, and deliver customized integrations.

Leverage AI to Improve Engineering Velocity
Use LLMs and modern AI development tools to accelerate workflows, understand complex systems, improve code quality, and increase delivery speed.

Champion Engineering Excellence
Help improve system reliability, observability, scalability, and performance while mentoring other engineers and contributing to a strong technical culture.

What You'll Bring

Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Deep expertise with TypeScript and modern JavaScript ecosystems.

  • Strong experience designing and building scalable backend services using Node.js.

  • Experience with GraphQL is preferred.

  • Proven ability to build complex web applications using React and/or React Native.

Engineering Leadership

  • Experience operating at a Staff Engineer level, driving technical direction without requiring formal authority.

  • Strong understanding of scalable architecture, system design, integrations, and distributed systems.

  • Ability to make thoughtful technical decisions while balancing business needs and long-term maintainability.

Startup Mindset

  • A strong bias toward action with the ability to operate effectively in an environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.

  • A track record of taking ownership, solving difficult problems, and delivering measurable impact.

  • Comfortable working across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

Builder’s Mindset

  • Genuine passion for technology and building products that solve meaningful business problems.

  • Experience in the building materials, construction, or related industries is an asset, but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $160,000 - $220,000 CAD annually, depending on experience.

This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates located in Canada.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/staff-software-developer-remote-canada-tlnt-bridge-recruiting

data.title: Backend Systems Engineer
data.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Senior Backend Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Backend Systems Engineer

Job Title: Backend Systems Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 6+ years
Salary: 100k - 150k
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.
Employment Type: Full-time, direct W2 with Bright Vision Technologies (no C2C, no 1099, no third-party)
Engagement: Long-term, multi-year, aligned to the Bright Vision SOW delivery roadmap
Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus benefits.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Backend Systems Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems to design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput backend services that power mission-critical workloads. In this role you will architect the core platforms that other engineering teams build on, focusing on scalability, reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. The ideal candidate will combine strong fundamentals in computer science with practical, battle-tested experience operating distributed systems at scale, and will be comfortable navigating the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement large-scale distributed backend systems using Java, Go, Scala, or similar high-performance languages.
  • Architect data partitioning, replication, and consistency strategies appropriate to each workload’s requirements.
  • Build resilient APIs and event-driven services with strong observability, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
  • Optimize systems for latency, throughput, and cost, using profiling, benchmarking, and load testing.
  • Lead detailed architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and trade-off analyses.
  • Implement robust failure-handling patterns including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and saga workflows.
  • Design and operate data stores at scale, including relational, key-value, document, and search engines.
  • Build comprehensive observability into services with structured logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
  • Drive incident response and post-incident learning for critical backend services.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead by example in code quality, design, and operational rigor.
  • Partner with SRE and platform teams to drive reliability improvements and reduce operational toil.
  • Contribute to long-term architecture and platform strategy, helping shape multi-year technical roadmaps and ensuring near-term execution remains aligned with the broader engineering direction.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant time on distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Scala, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including consensus, replication, and CAP trade-offs.
  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput message systems such as Kafka.
  • Experience operating systems at scale, including capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and mentorship skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms in production.
  • Exposure to service-mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
  • Familiarity with chaos engineering practices and tools.
  • Open-source contributions to relevant distributed systems projects.


How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
We recognize that our people are our strength, and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company.
We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Description

Ledgebrook is an InsurTech MGA on a mission to bring Specialty insurance into the modern era. Burdened with legacy technology and processes, the industry has not kept pace with the speed of innovation seen in other sectors. Positioned at the cutting edge of the next generation of InsurTech, Ledgebrook offers the best of both worlds: innovative world-class technology deployed by a leadership team armed with over 100 years of insurance expertise.

Our long-term vision is to become a diversified full stack Specialty re/insurer competing with legacy carriers in product lines & markets across the globe. To get there, Ledgebrook builds its premium base by rolling out a new Specialty product every ~6 months until we prove enough traction to raise a balance sheet, become a full stack carrier and eventually compete in the reinsurance markets. Our initial product is a domestic primary and excess GL E&S policies sourced via wholesale brokers.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star; fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages. We play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.

About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Full Stack Software Engineer to help us solve the complex, technical challenges of a changing insurance landscape. The ideal candidate loves to build, communicates well with team members , and is motivated by a less bureaucracy. experience_requirements.text: 3 years relevant work experience

data.description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

Role Overview:

The Data Exchange Specialist is responsible for managing the overall process, practice, and project implementation of electronic data interfaces with New York Life clients in support of Life, Accident, Disability, Family Medical Leave products, and various service offerings, with a strong focus on National Accounts and highly complex data integrations.

This role serves as both a technical and consultative resource, ensuring high-quality data exchange while educating clients on how their data powers downstream services including administration, billing, eligibility, enrollment, and reporting.

The Specialist understands how data flows through New York Life systems—from file receipt and validation to internal processing and operational impact—and proactively advises clients and TPAs on how data structure, file dependencies, and transmission timing affect service delivery and administration outcomes. They balance New York Life standards regarding layout, data integrity, and transmission protocols with client requirements to deliver compliant, scalable, and efficient solutions.

The Data Exchange Specialist manages multi-file data environments where multiple client files must be validated, sequenced, reconciled, and merged in order to support accurate system ingestion. These integrations often involve complex file structures, dependent file relationships, and conditional data mapping logic, requiring advanced technical expertise in file architecture, merge capabilities, and data validation.

This role also drives inventory control of active interfaces and milestone management in partnership with internal and external stakeholders. The Specialist demonstrates strong analytical capabilities to audit incoming files across multiple data sources, identify discrepancies or systemic errors, and implement corrective actions that improve data integrity and client experience.

The Data Exchange Specialist partners closely with Implementation IT, Family Medical Leave Operations, Account Management, and external Ben Tech vendors to ensure deadlines are met, key milestones are achieved, and implementation efforts stay aligned with business objectives.

Because this role supports large National Accounts and marquee clients, it requires the ability to manage high-volume, complex integrations with multiple vendors, benefit programs, and file dependencies. The Specialist must proactively assess data risk, ensure data governance standards are met, and maintain operational stability across interconnected systems.

Additionally, they act as a leader among peers by proactively contributing expertise, mentoring team members, taking on complex work, driving process improvements, and independently leading projects and training initiatives.

  • Integrate with TPAs and Ben Tech partners in support of eligibility, enrollment, remittance, and billing data for new and inforce business.
  • Serve as a consultative partner to clients and TPAs by educating them on data structure, file specifications, and the operational impact of their data across downstream administration systems.
  • Implement complex electronic interfaces based on established timelines while maintaining strict inventory control of active integrations, dependent file streams, and in-flight implementations.
  • Manage multi-file integration environments, ensuring files are received, validated, and sequenced appropriately for system ingestion and downstream processing.
  • Review, audit, and validate test data across multiple related files and data sources to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with business rules prior to production implementation.
  • Identify root causes of file discrepancies, mapping errors, transmission issues, or data inconsistencies across merged files, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Understand and articulate end-to-end data flow, including how files are received, validated, transformed, merged across multiple sources, and processed within New York Life systems.
  • Balance New York Life/LDEX standards regarding layout, data, and transmission protocols with client requirements, delivering compliant and scalable solutions for complex client environments.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation confirming the method of data exchange between New York Life and client/TPA, including file dependencies, mapping logic, merge requirements, and audit controls.
  • Partner with Production Support and IT to ensure successful receipt, mapping, merging, and processing of data.
  • Articulate complex file mapping and merge logic requirements clearly to IT and technical partners.
  • Drive accountability with internal teams and Ben Tech partners to meet key deliverables and milestone deadlines.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to electronic data exchange, multi-file integrations, and system processing impacts.
  • Track file status and ensure metrics are reported accurately within Salesforce.
  • Develop and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and training materials for complex integration processes and data governance practices.
  • Proactively review and suggest improvements to existing procedures to enhance efficiency, data integrity, and scalability of complex integrations.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for complex data exchange implementations and National Account integrations, providing guidance and mentorship to peers.

What You'll Bring:

data.title: Software Engineer, SMS Adapter
data.description:
About Ottimate

Ottimate is an AI-powered AP [Accounts Payable] automation platform that empowers finance teams to reduce costs, prevent overpayments, detect fraud, and enforce policy compliance across the entire invoice-to-payment lifecycle.

About the Role

Ottimate is expanding into the retail and grocery market. There, invoice and vendor data live inside store-level systems, such as POS, back-office, and inventory platforms like BRdata, rather than the ERPs we integrate with today.

The SMS Adapter makes that data usable: a secure connector that runs at the store or corporate office, pulls data directly from the store's system, and syncs it to Ottimate's AP platform. We're looking for a software engineer to own this adapter end-to-end, from the initial data connection and sync logic through to the security, reliability, and deployment experience that lets a non-technical store operator run it with confidence.

This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role. You'll be one of the first engineers dedicated to this product line, working closely with the retail/grocery product owner and store-side IT contacts at pilot customers.

Rsponsibilities

  • Build and maintain the adapter that connects to in-store systems, starting with BRdata, and syncs invoice items, vendor, and PO data to Ottimate.
  • Design and harden a reliable sync process: delta and full syncs, retry and backoff behavior, conflict handling, and clear failure visibility when a store's network or data source is unreliable.
  • Own local data handling and credential storage so the adapter can run unattended and securely on a store's machine.
  • Build and improve the setup and monitoring experience that store staff and support use to configure connections, check sync health, and troubleshoot issues without engineering involvement.
  • Establish strong automated test coverage for the adapter and keep it reliable across all target deployment environments (Windows is the primary target).
  • Own packaging, updates, and installation for software running on store-owned machines, often behind restrictive IT policies.
  • Work directly with pilot retail/grocery customers to diagnose environment issues, such as network, permissions, and data access, and turn them into product and reliability improvements.
  • Define and evolve the adapter's data model and mapping layer as we onboard additional store systems beyond BRdata.

Requirements

  • +5 YoE in strong software engineering experience, with a track record of owning a product end-to-end, from the data layer through the user-facing experience.
  • Experience building and shipping software that runs on end-user machines, including the packaging and distribution concerns that come with that.
  • Solid database experience, including comfort reverse-engineering schemas in third-party systems you don't control.
  • A track record of writing dependable integration and sync code: idempotency, retries, partial-failure handling, observability.
  • Practical testing instincts. You know when to reach for integration and end-to-end tests, not just unit tests, to catch real-world failure modes like a flaky store network or a locked-down machine.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity. This is a new, fast-moving product area without years of established internal convention to lean on.
  • Bonus: Prior experience with retail/grocery back-office systems, POS integrations, or field-deployed software supporting non-technical end users.

Why This Role

You'll be the engineering owner of a product that's foundational to Ottimate's entry into a new market. The work you ship directly determines whether retail and grocery customers can get their invoice data into Ottimate at all. You'll have significant latitude to shape the adapter's design, testing strategy, and roadmap as the product line grows.

Benefits

Benefits

We care deeply about making Ottimate an incredible place to work and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits/perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • Compensation: $160,000-180,000 USD /year.
  • Competitive salary based on skills & experience.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and other Company-Subsidized Benefits for you and your family.
  • Employer sponsored 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid Time Off (and the encouragement to use it).
  • Promote from within philosophy.

Beyond the tangible benefits though:

  • You will be part of a growing team, at a pinnacle moment of scale for the business, and experience the excitement of working in a startup where each action makes a huge difference.
  • You will have the agency to solve difficult problems creatively, the freedom to explore work that inspires you, and infrastructure to ensure you're constantly challenged and developing.
  • You will work with sharp, passionate teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and positioning our product as a premier finance automation solution.
  • Our commitment to empowering a diverse and inclusive workforce, celebrating differences, and creating a safe space for our employees to bring their whole selves to work is second to note.
  • We are transforming entire industries using innovative technology including Artificial Intelligence, Payment Tech, and Neural Networks.
  • Our leaders lead with a people-first approach; inspiring excellence, nurturing ideas, and finding creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth.
  • We truly love what we do and who we do it with - and we think you will too!

Ottimate is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or marital status. If you are excited about the role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. Nothin

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-ios-developer-swift-kotlin-multiplatform-ai-coding-m365connect

Job Description:

PRINCIPAL AI AUTONOMY SYSTEMS INTEGRATOR (UAS / SWARMING / C2 / EDGE AI)

Hands‑On Engineering • Autonomous System Integration • Mission‑Thread Enablement

Itegrate autonomy software with real assets, validate behaviors in simulation and field environments, and ensure that autonomous agents act over trusted data, in real time, under real mission pressures.

MISSION & IMPACT

Autonomy Integration & System Engineering

  • Integrate autonomy stacks onto UAS, multi‑vehicle swarms, and robotic platforms, including navigation, perception, cooperative behaviors, and distributed decision-making.
  • Implement real‑time autonomy pipelines that incorporate sensing, fusion, planning, and control across diverse air/ground systems.
  • Adapt and optimize autonomy algorithms for constrained edge environments (embedded systems, GPUs/VPUs, tactical compute nodes).

Data‑ and Knowledge‑Aligned Autonomy

  • Build data pipelines and semantic alignment layers so autonomous systems operate against trusted, structured, and meaning‑preserving data representations.
  • Integrate autonomy with ontology-driven or schema-governed data models to ensure consistent entity tracking, mission-state representation, and decision context.
  • Enable retrieval‑grounded behaviors where autonomous agents act based on authoritative, updated, and fused situational information.

Edge Deployment Across Contested Environments

  • Deploy AI/ML models and autonomy services to edge compute environments (K3s/RKE2, containers, bare metal).
  • Harden autonomy behaviors for degraded communications, GPS denial, EW threats, sensor loss, and variable latency.
  • Implement resilient synchronization patterns between edge devices and enterprise/tactical nodes.

Simulation, Experimentation, and Field Testing

  • Conduct structured field experiments with unmanned vehicles, swarms, multi‑agent behaviors, and C2 workflows.
  • Validate mission‑thread performance across detection, tasking, coordination, and operator-in-the-loop behaviors.

Agentic Workflow Integration

  • Integrate agent frameworks enabling autonomy agents to plan, coordinate, task, and interact with mission tools and human operators.
  • Define safety gates, oversight mechanisms, and deterministic tool‑use patterns that support “human‑on‑the‑loop” operations.
  • Support multi‑agent cooperation through standard APIs and interoperable messaging patterns.

C2, Networks, and Cross‑Domain Integration

  • Integrate autonomous systems with tactical C2 platforms, data links, secure communications, and multi‑domain operational workflows.
  • Implement open standards (MOSA, SOSA, CMOSS, open messaging protocols) for plug‑and‑play component integration.
  • Enable interoperability across joint, partner‑nation, and coalition environments with appropriate policy controls.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build full autonomy pipelines end‑to‑end, from sensing through action execution.
  • Deploy CV, tracking, SLAM, pattern‑learning, anomaly detection, and cooperative‑agent models on real unmanned systems.
  • Integrate heterogeneous sensors, radios, and payloads with autonomy decision loops.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and rapid problem resolution across autonomy software, embedded systems, edge clusters, and C2 interfaces.
  • Translate mission problems into executable autonomy behaviors and scenario‑specific workflows.
  • Train teams and mission personnel on system configuration, safety, deployment, and best practices.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Core Background

  • Education: BA/BS or equivalent
  • Experience: 10+ years in unmanned systems, autonomy engineering, robotics integration, or embedded AI/ML deployment.
  • Direct experience integrating autonomy into UAS, drones, swarms, robotic vehicles, or similar platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, Python, and real‑time/embedded software patterns.

Technical Expertise

  • Autonomy functions: motion planning, cooperative behaviors, obstacle avoidance, distributed coordination, sensor fusion, and real‑time decision-making.
  • Robotics frameworks: ROS/ROS2, PX4/ArduPilot, MAVLink, simulation tools (Gazebo, AirSim, custom environments).
  • AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, JAX.
  • Edge compute: NVIDIA Jetson, VPUs, ruggedized x86 nodes, tactical accelerators.
  • Containerization and DevSecOps: Docker, Kubernetes (K3s/RKE2), GitLab CI, ArgoCD.
  • Interoperability standards: open architectures, modular interfaces, secure API design.

Domain Understanding

  • Experience supporting C2 integration, tactical networks, and degraded-communication workflows.
  • Understanding of multi‑domain mission threads such as ISR, counter‑UAS, logistics autonomy, multi-agent coordination, and decision-support.
  • Experience designing resilient behavior under environmental, adversarial, and operational stressors.

Security Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Top Secret/SCI Required to start

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with distributed track fusion, detection/classification pipelines, or multi-sensor correlation.
  • Familiarity with mission‑partner interoperability and cross‑domain data release patterns.
  • Experience implementing provenance, auditability, and safety‑bounded autonomy behaviors.
  • Background in private 5G, tactical mesh networking, or mobile operations centers.

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

This Principal-level role is tailored for someone who:

  • Builds autonomy that works in real field conditions, not just in demos.
  • Bridges AI models, mission data, and real unmanned systems.
  • Ensures autonomous behaviors are grounded in trusted, structured information.
  • Understands both the engineering and the operational realities of deploying autonomy at scale.
  • Can integrate across sensors, payloads, compute, C2, and enterprise systems.

You are the person who makes autonomous systems reliable, interoperable, safe, and mission-ready.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

Important Notice: While we don't currently have an immediate opening for a Backend Engineer in Portugal, we're proactively building a talent pipeline for future opportunities. If your profile aligns with what we're looking for, we'd love to consider you as new positions become available.

Your Mission

On our path to becoming the most visited online curated marketplace for special objects, our Engineering team is on a mission to deliver the best experience across our platforms by building best-in-class products for search and discovery, bidding, curation, logistics, payments, and support.

We’re a scale-up tackling customer-facing challenges at high scale, with 75,000 auctions per week and more than 10 million visitors per month. As a Backend Engineer, you’ll support one of our three verticals - Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment - improving and delivering product innovations for our platform.
Working in a small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile team, you will build scalable, maintainable, and resilient microservices and features. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.

What You'll Do

You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.

  • Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.
  • Own what you deliver, taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.
  • Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.
  • Improve how we work, identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.
  • Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.
  • Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.
  • Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.

What You'll Bring

You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.

  • Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.
  • Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.
  • Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.
  • API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.
  • Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.
  • Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.
  • Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.
  • Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.

How We Work

Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.

  • Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.
  • Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.
  • We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.
  • Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week.
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in Portugal. As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.
  • Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior iOS Engineer to join a cloud-native engineering team working on modern, customer-facing mobile applications and digital experiences.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining deep native iOS development expertise with AWS cloud technologies, modern application architecture, CI/CD, testing, and direct customer collaboration.

You will work alongside Engineers, Architects, Engineering Managers, and Project Managers to design and deliver high-quality solutions for complex mobile initiatives. The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, the ability to build and maintain production-ready iOS applications, and confidence working directly with customer engineering teams.

The ideal candidate brings deep Swift and native iOS expertise, strong knowledge of application design and development patterns, AWS experience, and the communication skills required to succeed in a consulting and client-facing environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, maintain, and enhance production-grade native iOS applications.
  • Develop high-quality mobile solutions using Swift and modern iOS development practices.
  • Collaborate with Architects and Engineering Managers to translate technical requirements into scalable solutions.

  • Integrate mobile applications with APIs, cloud services, SDKs, and external platforms.
  • Contribute to mobile initiatives involving tracking, attribution, deep linking, in-app experiences, and customer journey optimization.
  • Write production-ready, well-tested, maintainable, and documented code.
  • Build and maintain automated testing for mobile applications.
  • Contribute to and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting mobile application delivery.
  • Work with AWS services and cloud-native architectures supporting mobile applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and demos.
  • Collaborate directly with customer engineering teams and clearly communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Requirements:

  • Strong understanding of iOS application architecture and software design patterns.
  • Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production applications.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with APIs, SDKs, and backend/cloud services.
  • Strong experience working with AWS cloud environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD and mobile application delivery automation.
  • Strong understanding of testing and software quality practices.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical decisions and trade-offs.

Must Have:

  • Strong hands-on Swift development experience.

  • Experience building and supporting production mobile applications.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Mobile application architecture.
    • Software design patterns.

    • Ability to work effectively with Engineers, Architects, Engineering Managers, and customer technical teams.

Nice to Have:

data.description:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might know us as ZnanyLekarz in Poland or Doctoralia in Spain. Globally, we are Docplanner.

We build technology that helps people live longer, healthier lives. Our products connect patients with doctors, power clinical workflows, and support healthcare systems used by millions of people every month.

Engineering at Docplanner is about building reliable, scalable systems with real human impact. What we ship affects patients, doctors, and clinics in everyday, high-stakes situations - which means quality, judgment, and long-term thinking matter.

In 2026, we are accelerating delivery across multiple product areas by changing how we build - leveraging AI-assisted development to increase engineering effectiveness and raise the bar on how we design, ship, and evolve systems.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self. You can decide to work fully remote, or work hybrid with our offices located in Barcelona or Warsaw. This will be dependent on the final team allocation.

Our challenges

Our Engineers may join teams working on these areas and challenges:

Marketplace & Search

Build the next-generation marketplace system by owning the end-to-end journey from agentic discovery to rebooking. You’ll leverage AI search and AI onboarding funnels to unlock new demand and transform one-off bookings into continuous care loops.

Practice Management Systems (PMS)

Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient.

AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic)

Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. You'll build deep PMS/EHR embeddings that become an indispensable daily habit for medical professionals.

Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient)

Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without.

Internally, these challenges map to some of our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives.

How we build software

  • We build systems that matter and we optimize for clarity, speed, and long-term maintainability.

  • Small autonomous teams that own real product surfaces end-to-end

  • High trust and high ownership from day one

  • Production impact early - even as a junior engineer

  • AI-assisted development as a default workflow

  • Strong engineering culture focused on simplicity, correctness, and measurable outcomes

  • We prefer solving problems well over adding unnecessary complexity.

  • Good ideas win regardless of tenure or hierarchy.

What we value

Strong problem solving ability. The ability to break down complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Builder mindset. You like creating things that people use.

Intellectual curiosity. You enjoy understanding how systems really work.

Ownership. You treat problems as yours until they are solved.

Pragmatism. You know when to optimize and when to ship.

We value signals over credentials.

Competition programming, open-source work, research, side projects or anything else that shows how you think.

Technical Environment

  • Our stack evolves continuously, but currently includes technologies such as:

  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Mobile: React Native

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform

  • Developer tooling: modern CI/CD, observability

  • AI-assisted coding environments built to scale (guardrails, rules, skills, subagents, spec-driven development)

We invest heavily in developer productivity and continuously improve how we design and ship systems.

Collaboration Model

• Open source internal culture - contribute across different services and teams

• Maintainer guidance rather than gatekeeping from senior developers

• Cross-functional ownership of features from conception to deployment

• Living documentation shared across all team members

Why Junior Devs Love It Here

  • Some reasons engineers choose to stay at Docplanner:

  • Real scale. Millions of users and thousands of healthcare providers across multiple countries.

  • Interesting problems. Distributed systems, search relevance, AI-assisted workflows, complex integrations.

  • Exceptional teammates. Work with talented people across disciplines who raise the bar for everyone.

  • Fast learning curve. You will work on real production systems very early.

  • Meaningful mission. Helping people live longer, healthier lives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong foundations in computer science

  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, complexity, and core software engineering principles.

  • Ability to build real software

  • Comfortable working across the stack to design, implement, and ship features that solve real user problems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • You enjoy breaking down complex problems and finding simple, effective solutions.

  • Builder mindset

  • You like turning ideas into working products and taking ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Curiosity about users and problems

  • You’re comfortable talking to users, understanding their needs, and iterating on solutions.

  • High learning velocity

  • You pick up new technologies, tools, and domains quickly and continuously improve your craft.

  • AI-first engineering mindset

  • You actively experiment with AI coding tools, agents, and new workflows, and are excited about reinventing how software is built.

Preferred

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another rigorous technical discipline.

  • Competitive programming experience

  • Participation in ICPC, Google Code Jam, national olympiads, Codeforces, or similar competitions.

  • Evidence of building things

  • Side projects, startups, open-source contributions, hackathons, or shipped products.

  • Exposure to modern engineering workflows

  • Experience working with collaborative development, continuous delivery, strong observability, and AI-assisted development practices.

Benefits

  • Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings;

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona;

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

  • Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier);

  • 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays;

  • Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental);

  • Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Wellhub.

  • Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

  • Free English classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

The client is a global insights and strategy firm operating at the intersection of content, culture, and technology, partnering with clients across entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming. The company combines research, analytics, software engineering, and AI-driven solutions to deliver actionable insights, support strategic decision-making, and drive innovation.


Job Summary

The project focuses on developing, enhancing, and maintaining the client's product portfolio, including modern web applications, backend services, data-intensive systems, and AI-enabled workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, enhance, and maintain features across the client's product portfolio.

  • Build and support modern frontend applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

  • Develop and integrate backend services, RESTful APIs, and data-driven applications.

  • Work with relational databases and SQL to support product functionality and data-intensive systems.

  • Use AI tools as part of daily software development, including coding, testing, debugging, and optimization.

  • Review and validate AI-generated code to ensure quality, security, performance, and maintainability.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, research, design, data, and QA teams to define and implement practical technical solutions.

  • Write and maintain automated unit, integration, and API tests.

  • Participate in code reviews, documentation, CI/CD workflows, and production readiness activities.

  • Contribute to scalable data visualization experiences and continuously improve engineering practices.

  • Ensure software is secure, observable, maintainable, and aligned with product and business priorities.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing production software using Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern backend language.

  • 1+ years of professional experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.

  • 1+ years of professional experience building applications with React.

  • 3+ years of experience writing SQL and working with relational databases.

  • Practical experience using AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle, including code generation, testing, debugging, and optimization.

  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated output and identify potential quality, security, and data governance risks.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including software design, data structures, algorithms, and performance optimization.

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and deliver reliable production software.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Java with Spring / Spring Boot.

  • C#/.NET, ASP.NET, WCF, or Oracle.

  • Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience with automated unit, integration, and API testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD and production deployment practices.

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

  • Snowflake or BigQuery.

  • Experience with legacy application modernization.

  • Experience with data-intensive applications, analytics, visualization, and AI-enabled products.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

data.title: Senior C++ Engineer
data.description:
FinDev is looking for a Senior C++ Developer to join a team building and evolving a large-scale, real-time electronic trading platform for the global Fixed Income market.


The team develops the application layer of an institutional corporate bond trading platform, supporting a range of trading protocols and workflows.

You’ll work primarily with modern C++ on Linux, building and enhancing server-side components responsible for trading workflows, order and trade lifecycle, business logic, and integrations with other systems across the platform.

Locations

  • Georgia
  • Poland
  • Portugal
  • Cyprus
  • Spain

What you will do

  • Enhance and maintain the core list-management service at the center of our electronic corporate bond trading platform, owning the full lifecycle of trade negotiation and execution across a growing set of trading protocols
  • Build and extend the integration services that bridge our platform to internal and external trading systems
  • Work in C++ on Linux in a microservices architecture built on a shared service framework with schema-driven code generation (FlatBuffers and Protobuf)
  • Contribute during all phases of the project lifecycle
  • Work with business counterparts to provide technical solutions to client needs
  • Work with QA and support teams to address issues that arise during development, testing, and in production

Required

  • 8+ years of commercial C++ development for production services; C++20 preferred, strong C++17 acceptable
  • Strong modern C++ fundamentals, including STL, templates and generic programming, RAII and object lifetimes, design patterns, and core concurrency concepts. Comfort with template-heavy C++ code is important
  • Experience building, debugging, and profiling Linux services in production
  • Ability to select appropriate data structures and algorithms for correct, efficient business logic
  • Experience with microservices or service integrations in distributed systems
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL.

Nice to have

  • Experience with electronic trading, order-management workflows, or fixed-income markets.
  • Background in low-latency or high-throughput systems, network protocols, or pub/sub architectures.
  • Familiarity with Protobuf, FlatBuffers, Redis, or similar infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience with Python, shell scripting, CMake/Conan, or AI-assisted development tools.

Benefits

  • Flexible work setup: remote or a hybrid model.
  • Health insurance coverage for those based in Poland and Cyprus.
  • 50% coverage of health insurance for spouses and children in Poland and Cyprus.
  • 24 days of paid vacation.
  • 10 days of paid sick leave.
  • 50% reimbursement for professional training, education, conferences.
  • Work alongside a highly professional team.
  • Engaging teambuilding events and activities.
  • Relocation Package: assistance for relocation to Poland or Cyprus, if desired.


In case of relocation to Cyprus and Poland, we offer:

  • Flight tickets, accommodation rent for 1st month for our relocated employee and his/her official family.
  • Visa sponsorship, including support with the visa application process, entry permits, and residence permits.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own high-impact projects end-to-end from concept through production, in a fast-moving environment where engineers focus on building a great product. You'll work across our codebase alongside a small, highly autonomous team, shipping multiple times a day. This is a role for someone who finds intrinsic motivation in building, moves fast without cutting corners, and measures success by what's live in production.

Key Responsibilities

Own and deliver major features end-to-end, from initial prototype to production deployment

Take full responsibility for the quality and polish of what you ship: performant code, pixel-perfect UI, and thoughtful error handling

Drive technical decisions with strong judgment, knowing when an RFC adds value versus overhead, and when to bet on speed over completeness

Diagnose production issues using instrumentation and measurement (not vibes), and leave the codebase better than you found it

Actively shape what gets built: attend customer calls, question priorities, and ensure the work you're doing delivers real, measurable impact rather than ticking off a spec

Who You Are

You have deep full-stack engineering experience and a track record of shipping customer-facing features in a high-growth environment

You default to action over process - you'd rather ship something imperfect and iterate than spend weeks perfecting an abstraction nobody's tested in the real world

You're genuinely autonomous: you know your top priority, why it matters, what's next, and you don't wait for a meeting or a manager to tell you

You care about craft without being precious - you write clean, reviewable code, sweat the details on UI polish and backend consistency, but never let "perfect" delay "live"

You thrive in a high-trust, low-overhead environment where you're empowered to make bold calls and accountable when those bets don't pay off

You're a strong communicator who asks sharp questions, shares context publicly, and treats the codebase as a shared space you're proud to maintain

Bonus Qualifications

Experience building AI-powered product features

Proven track record in high-growth startup environments

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Salary Range $170-230K + equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage

  • $20K relocation assistance and visa sponsorship

  • High autonomy and direct collaboration with leadership

We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.

The Senior Sitecore Developer is a member of a cross-functional web development team responsible for building enterprise level web applications using technologies including .NET and Sitecore. This Senior Developer is a strong communicator who excels at collaborating with team members and conveying technical concepts to other developers and managers. The ideal candidate has strong technical skills utilizing clean and solid programming techniques, web security practices, and design patterns.

What you’ll do:

  • Estimate the scale and scope of individual work tasks assigned and support other team members in estimating their tasks based on prior experience.
  • Break down large and complex bodies of work into smaller units and establish dependencies.
  • Support Solution Architects and Technology Leads in brainstorming technical solutions and writing Proof of Concept code to ensure ideas can be implemented.
  • Develop new .NET based functionalities and applications in Visual Studio.
  • Develop websites within the Sitecore CMS framework.
  • Ensure all solutions are documented and meet design requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovative and effective user experiences through technology.
  • Execute solutions on time and on budget using modern web development methods, techniques and tools.

Who you are:

  • Enthusiastic about developing the best solutions and providing the ultimate customer experience.
  • Interested in staying current by applying new technologies.
  • Able to work in a collaborative environment with a willingness to share your ideas and accept feedback.
  • Comfortable working independently and completing tasks with attention to quality and velocity, while unafraid to seek out suggestions from team members.
  • Excited to be creative and innovative while working on cutting-edge technology.

data.title: Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Who we are:

Magellan AI gives brands, agencies and publishers visibility into the podcast advertising market and proof that it works. Our audio analysis and NLP track ad placements across thousands of shows. Our measurement and attribution tools connect those ads to the traffic and conversions they drive, so buyers can optimize campaigns and sellers can prove performance.

We are looking to hire an experienced full-stack developer to join our team of seven engineers, to help launch a major new feature and continue to enhance our core product. The job has changed shape over the past year: most of our code is now drafted by AI agents — Claude Code and Codex — working under close supervision. We ship considerably more than we used to, and the scarce skill is no longer typing speed. It is knowing what to build, specifying it precisely, and being able to tell a correct answer from a convincing one. We are seeking someone who can handle many responsibilities, including:

  • Adding new features to our Ruby on Rails application from top-to-bottom, full stack. You will work with operations and sales to help creatively design ‘good enough’ yet professional solutions.
  • Directing AI coding agents through real work: framing the problem and its constraints, reviewing what comes back line by line, pushing back when a solution has outgrown the problem, and starting over simpler when that is the right call. You own the result regardless of who typed it.
  • Increasing system/code quality by using practices such as TDD and refactoring. Quality around the core of the system has become more important as we scale up — and more important still now that the volume of code we produce has gone up.
  • Writing the design down before the code: specs, architecture decision records, and product documentation for our operations team. Precise writing is a core engineering skill here, because it is both how we align with each other and how we brief our agents.
  • Extending our own tooling — the skills, subagents and CLI helpers that encode how we work. Codifying a workflow so the whole team, and their agents, can repeat it is ordinary, reviewed work here.
  • Building AI-facing product surfaces, like our Ad Intelligence MCP server, where the consumer of the API you design is a language model rather than a browser — with the authentication, policy gates and audit logging that implies.
  • Enhancing usability of existing features via Turbo/Stimulus and other front-end improvements.
  • Troubleshooting and fixing performance issues and complicated logic across Postgres and ClickHouse. Help simplify the system by bringing in smart design decisions.
  • Experimenting and providing stopgap solutions for potential opportunities. Sometimes this involves quick and dirty solutions such as scripting, SQL exports, web scraping and the like.
  • Sharing in providing operational support to make sure the system stays running and address any bugs. (Most usage is during normal business hours…we don’t do pagers.)
  • Experimenting via internal hackathons to produce novel solutions and feature enhancements.

Software Development at Magellan AI

We adhere to a lightweight Agile development process.

  • Every week, we have one formal product meeting with the revenue and operations team to reset priorities. The rest of the time is self-directed, with developers figuring out how to best solve any problems. In general, we are not working against any deadlines and make sure we take the time to do the job right.
  • We practice Collective Code Ownership so that anyone can change any line of code and anyone can introduce new libraries or tools.
  • We deploy code on a regular basis, usually every day. IOW, we ship fast and learn fast. A typical recent week is around 45 pull requests merged.
  • Claude Code and Codex do most of the typing. Engineers spend their time deciding what to build, writing the spec, and judging what comes back.
  • We work one task per git worktree, which lets each of us keep several agent sessions running in parallel on isolated branches. Managing that parallelism is a skill in itself, and we will teach it.
  • Every change runs a review gauntlet before it merges: a local pre-PR review, a cross-agent review where Codex critiques Claude’s work, GitHub Copilot’s automated review (our branch rules will not let us merge until every thread is resolved), and a human reviewer. Different models catch different things.
  • We invest heavily in the context our agents read: a repository-level conventions file, roughly two dozen project-specific skills, and purpose-built subagents. When someone learns something the hard way, it gets written down where the next agent will find it.
  • Decisions get recorded as ADRs — we are up to 159 — and business rules live in a shared documentation repository linked into every worktree, so both people and agents can find out why the system works the way it does.
  • We usually host a biweekly team retrospective to discuss ways to improve communication and collaboration.
  • We make it easy for the tech-adjacent team members to run QA with clear documentation and steps to test our work.

Tools and Technologies

The main application is Ruby on Rails, hosted on Heroku, with Postgres as the primary database and ClickHouse behind our measurement and attribution product. Background work runs on Sidekiq. JavaScript in the application is minimal, and is mostly Turbo and Stimulus with some Bootstrap. A separate Python application handles all of the machine learning. Infrastructure is managed in Terraform across AWS, GCP and Cloudflare. Day to day we work in Claude Code and Codex, with MCP servers wired into ClickHouse, Postgres, New Relic, Rollbar, CircleCI and Trello so our agents can gather their own evidence.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • Expertise with Agile web development, with practices such as TDD and Refactoring
  • Fluency working with AI coding agents day to day, or the obvious appetite for it. You do not need our exact toolchain, but you should be someone who reviews what an agent hands you rather than trusting it.
  • Clear writing. You will be writing specs, ADRs and documentation read by people who are not engineers.

Nice to Have:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • ClickHouse
  • Python
  • NYC-based
  • Experience designing MCP servers or other LLM-facing APIs
  • Background in ad tech
  • Interest in the podcasting world

Compensation and benefits:

  • Competitive base salary and bonus structure
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage - individual coverage is free
  • Company-subsidized family coverage
  • Home office improvement reimbursement up to $500 per year
  • Company laptop and external monitor
  • 11 company holidays
  • 20 PTO days for vacation, illness, and personal time

More about Magellan AI

Magellan AI is a first mover, early-stage SaaS startup funded by Brooklyn Bridge Ventures, C2 ventures and a few independent investors. The company was founded in 2016 by Cameron Hendrix (formerly Goldman Sachs) and Rex Madden (formerly Stride Consulting NYC). Magellan AI is the all-in-one platform for audio advertising intelligence, media planning, and measurement. Advertiser and agency media buyers rely on Magellan AI's audio media planning and measurement platform to discover, connect with, and analyze the performance of broadcast radio, podcasts, streaming audio, and YouTube. Publishers trust Magellan AI to grow audio ad sales with intelligence and performance measurement, powered by the world's largest database of podcast advertising data, covering over 60,000 podcasts. You will have the chance to shape the direction of a popular product in a rapidly evolving industry.

We’re a remote-first company (though we’re still based in NYC). We offer great benefits for our size (medical, dental, equipment stipend, vacation), off-site retreats, as well as a generous options grant.

Magellan AI is an equal opportunity employer; in keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on gender, sexual orientation, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital domestic partner status, physical ability, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on 'protected categories,' we also strive to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our company culture. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Magellan AI.

Salary: $100,000 – $140,000 / year
